en: The image shows the written/back side of an old postcard. It has brown handwritten text in Estonian on the left and address information on the right. There is a red postage stamp in the upper right corner with a denomination of 15 (likely Estonian senti) and several black circular postmarks. The most legible postmarks read "POLTSAMAA EESTI 14 X 26" and "TALLINN EESTI 15 X 26," indicating dates in October 1926. The address is written to a person in Kopli, a district of Tallinn.
